proposed_capability: Add an explicit, offline, deterministic, non-executable candidate-export, strict schema validation and independent two-cohort research benchmark for opted-in local semantic VAE weights; contributors may voluntarily submit inert learning artifacts for human-controlled developer review. No automatic upload, adoption, trusted authorship or gameplay effects.
player_save_control_impact: Local training stays profile and context scoped, opt-in and private by default. Separate explicit consent is required to export model weights; weights can still leak training information. Export excludes raw samples, replay IDs, world/save hashes and names. Untrusted candidates are JSON-only data, never imported to live native gameplay or authorized as a controller. Developers and maintainers must manually review security, licensing and genuinely independent multi-host holdout evidence.
expected_outcome: Existing local VAE remains unmodified; a CLI explicitly drafts a bounded context-free tensor-only candidate, validates strict allowlisted schema, detects tampering, and evaluates inert reconstruction across two independently supplied reviewer holdouts. The repository can review contributions without accidentally shipping private raw data or executable artifacts. Separate provenance/security/reproducibility and cross-machine validation remain required before adoption.
negative_tests: Local training consent does not imply export or network consent
No permission or undertrained model yields no contribution artifact
Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, nonfinite/non-numeric tensors, invalid shapes, oversized payloads and changed tensor digests
Never serialize context_hash, samples, seen_bloom, save IDs or profile IDs
Synthetic/self-reported metrics are not promotion proof
Two identical test cohorts are not independent
Underperforming or adversarial candidate never passes research benchmark
No model candidate grants game/OS action authority
No automatic developer approval, code merge, telemetry, download or update
rollback_path: Revert isolated scripts/tests/docs/contracts PR; no model storage changes, no user profile migration, no live hook, network sharing or save/game modifications. Retain existing local model and BI-002 gate.
unresolved_unknowns: No independently attested cross-host Sims 4 trained candidate or trusted heldout dataset available through GitHub provider
No live Windows game host, package implementation or verified gameplay effect
Reviewers must establish real provenance, privacy leakage resistance, malicious model behavior screening and multi-host efficacy before acceptance
Developer candidacy and repository write privileges remain human-controlled
decision_rationale: Reuse the already implemented local opt-in VAE and semantic input contract. Reject automatic federation, raw save/screenshot sharing, executable model formats, and promotion on author-only reports. Select bounded data-only candidate intake with explicit sharing consent and independent review gate, separating structural validation from true security and cross-host effectiveness.
